description: Dashboard UX Revamp — replace 3-way toggle with banner + 2-column card grid + detail drill-down

userStories.title: Balance home — banner + 2-column grid
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my calorie balance and key metrics at a glance from the main dashboard without switching tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardViewMode toggle removed from DashboardContent; 3-way segmented control deleted

New DashboardHome composable renders: CalorieBalanceBannerCard (full-width ElevatedCard, tonalElevation=4.dp) showing net balance signed ('+320 kcal' green if >=0, red if <0) from balances.sumOf{it.balance}.roundToInt() in displayMedium; below that '🏃 X min' weeklyCardioMinutes in bodyMedium MiTextSecondary
Row of two equal-width ElevatedCard items (Modifier.weight(1f) each, tonalElevation=2.dp, Modifier.padding(8.dp) gap): left=Intake, right=Expenditure
Intake card: title 'Intake' (labelSmall, MiOrange), total kcal in (balances.sumOf{it.intake}.roundToInt(), bodyLarge, onSurface)
Expenditure card: title 'Expenditure' (labelSmall, MiOrange), total kcal out (balances.sumOf{it.burn}.roundToInt(), bodyLarge, onSurface)
DashboardContent renders DashboardHome when selectedLens==null; DashboardDetail when selectedLens!=null (placeholder onBack/onBarClick lambdas ok for this story)
selectedLens: DashboardViewMode? state hoisted in DashboardContent (initially null)

userStories.title: Detail drill-down — chart + history for selected lens
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap an Intake or Expenditure card and see the full chart and daily history for that lens so I can analyze trends.
acceptanceCriteria: New DashboardDetail composable: takes balances: List<DailyBalance>, viewMode: DashboardViewMode (INTAKE or EXPENDITURE), onBack: () -> Unit, onBarClick: (DailyBalance) -> Unit

DashboardDetail renders: back IconButton (Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, tint=MiOrange) in the header row alongside date navigator; SlidingWindowInsightCard(balances, viewMode); history rows as CondensedLogItem list (reverse-chronological) scoped to selected viewMode
Tapping Intake card sets selectedLens = DashboardViewMode.INTAKE; tapping Expenditure sets selectedLens = DashboardViewMode.EXPENDITURE
Back button sets selectedLens = null, returning to DashboardHome
BreakdownDialog still opens on bar tap (unchanged behavior)
BALANCE DashboardViewMode not handled in DashboardDetail (banner handles balance; no detail drill for BALANCE)
